en.bdb: Holiness of the Gurmukh way of life

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀਆ ਨਾਲੇ ਵਾਹੜੇ ਗੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੰਗੋਦਕ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: nadheeaa naale vaahaRe ga(n)g sa(n)g ga(n)godhak hoiee|

en.bdb: Rivers and small streams joining Ganges become the sacred river (Ganges).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸੈ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: asaT dhaat ik dhaat hoi paaras parasai ka(n)chan soiee|

en.bdb: With the touch of the philosopher's stone (paras) all the mixed light metals are transformed into gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਕਰ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਗੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat afal safal kar cha(n)dhan goiee|

en.bdb: The vegetation whether fruit producing or fruitless becomes sandal by assimilating into the fragrance of sandal.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਝੈ ਸੁਝ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rut baareh maeh kar sujhai sujh na dhoojaa koiee|

en.bdb: In the six seasons and twelve months nothing except sun is  there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨਿ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟ ਭਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan chhia dharasanaa baareh vaaT bhavai sabh loiee|

en.bdb: Four varnas, six Schools of philosophy and twelve sects of the yogis are there in this world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh dharasan saadhasa(n)g gurmukh maarag dhubidhaa khoiee|

en.bdb: But by treading the path of Gurmukhs all the dubieties of the above sects vanish.
They (Gurmukhs) now with stable  mind adore the One (Lord).
